Audit complete (read-only). Exact evidence: `handoff/LEDGER.md:315`, Orders 109–115, `BUILD-PLAN.md:93-123`, and UAT sections 08/09/12/13.

Dependency/status:

- Order 109 — transfer/adjustment/reversal: `READY`, policy-approved under D-344; blocked only by current-line/Cyber sequencing and reserved migration 0012 (Order 118). Delivers immutable partial/full charge correction, same-property folio transfer, approval binding, sealed-day/date authority.
- Order 110 — token-only payment foundation: `DRAFT`, blocked on independently approved 109. Delivers token-only auth/increment/capture/void/refund/reconciliation and provider receipts. Auth/increment/void create no journals; capture/refund do.
- Order 111 — hosted payment/deposit workbench: `DRAFT`, blocked on 109–110. Delivers hosted deposit link, signed callback, deposit liability capture, explicit partial/full deposit application. Never settles.
- Order 112 — governed cashier sessions: `DRAFT`, blocked on 111. Delivers drawer custody, immutable denomination counts/recounts, over/short evidence, seal blocking. Explicitly no cash payment/refund/journal; expected cash is opening float because 110 is token-only.
- Order 113 — folio settlement/receivables: `DRAFT`, blocked on 112. Delivers additional folio windows, exact-zero settlement, and authorized transfer of positive debt to party-specific company/agent receivable. Explicitly no checkout, invoice, full AR, tax, export.
- Order 114 — trust negative authorization: «REDACTED-SECRET», blocked on 109–113. Delivers accounting-only owner expense/payable accrual with credit-normal trust balance and four-eyes approval for projected negative funds. No bank payout/reconciliation.
- Order 115 — Phase-5 gate: `DRAFT`, blocked on approved 109–114. Orchestrates a deterministic finance journey and evidence gate; explicitly stops before check-in, checkout, tax, housekeeping, etc. It cannot claim full UAT completion.

Finance journey delivered by 109–115:

- Existing foundation: generic single untaxed `postCharge`, folio statement/balance, balanced immutable journals, business-day/sealed-day primitives.
- 109: correction lineage and simple folio-to-folio transfer.
- 110/111: token/hosted deposits and payment lifecycle, including capture/refund, but not cash.
- 112: cashier custody/count evidence only.
- 113: zero-only folio settlement and bounded direct-billing receivable transfer.
- 114: trust negative guard and payable accrual.
- 115: command-driven Phase-5 integration proof only.

Gaps versus UAT:

- UAT-08 POS/source receipts: absent. No outlet/service command, itemized checks, check number, server/driver, quantities, tax evidence, tip/discount, or outlet-scoped UI. Generic untaxed charge is insufficient.
- UAT-08 charge-to-in-house eligibility: absent. Existing charge validates open folio/account/property/day but does not require reservation status `in_house`; a successor must add this boundary before POS/room-service/taxi/minibar posting.
- UAT-09 splits by person/room: absent. 109’s transfer moves one bounded balance between eligible folios; it is not source-check item allocation, named payer attribution, deterministic rounding, or multi-room/multi-person split/routing.
- UAT-12 payments/refunds: 110 covers token auth/capture/refund/void/reconciliation and 111 hosted deposit path, but no cash payment/refund, no real provider, and no checkout integration. 112 explicitly forbids cash accounting.
- UAT-12 settlement/checkout: 113 settles zero folios or transfers debt to eligible receivables, but checkout, occupancy release/trim, access revocation, and departure-cleaning trigger are absent (Phase 6).
- UAT-12 tax/GST/fiscal: wholly absent; Phase 7 required. No tax assignment, room-night slabs, legal invoice/credit/debit/replacement document, GSTIN/billing identity handling, IRP/fiscal submission provenance.
- UAT-13 correction/history: 109 does provide immutable correction journals and lineage for untaxed charges; it does not cover issued statutory-document correction lineage (explicit UAT prerequisite).
- UAT-13 cashier/day close: 112 provides drawer count/over-short and prevents sealing with an open session, but creates no cash journals and does not reconcile outlet/payment/tax/AR feeds.
- UAT-13 trust: 114 covers one owner-expense accrual and negative authorization, not trust/client-money reconciliation, owner statements, payouts, or broader trust controls.
- UAT-13 SAP/QuickBooks export: explicitly deferred by 113/115; no mapping, receipt/retry, reconciliation, or export adapter.

Contradictions/collision risks:

- 109 and 113 both use “transfer,” but are distinct: 109 is guest-folio ↔ guest-folio correction/transfer; 113 is guest-folio → eligible company/agent receivable plus folio windows. Successor contracts must preserve separate tx codes, permissions, lineage, and semantics.
- 110 supports refunds only against captured token payment purposes; UAT-12’s cash refund remains unimplemented, and 111 forbids deposit refunds.
- 112’s cashier evidence is intentionally non-accounting; do not interpret over/short as a balanced journal or as cash-payment capability.
- 113’s “settlement” is only an exact-zero folio status update (or receivable routing), not hotel checkout, invoice, fiscal settlement, or payment settlement.
- 115’s zero-trial-balance requirement is an integration proof over implemented slices, not evidence that POS/tax/checkout/close/export exists.
- The migration sequence in the order headers (0014–0019) is mechanically shifted because Order 118 owns 0012; this is documented in the ledger and must remain unchanged.

Recommended scope-preserving successor sequence:

1. Finish 109, then 110 → 111 → 112 → 113 → 114, with independent Tier-3 review at each high-risk tip; execute 115 only after all six are approved.
2. POS/source-charge slice: outlet/service identity, itemized receipt/check evidence, tax-evidence payload, governed codes, outlet-scoped reads, and mandatory `in_house`/eligible reservation check. Reuse `postCharge`; no splits or tax engine yet.
3. Shared-bill allocation slice: source-check allocations by named payer/person and room/folio, windows/routing, deterministic remainder policy, immutable reclassification/transfer lineage, replay/concurrency/correction proofs. Keep separate from receivables transfer.
